title: IngestionRequest payload (Go to Python), schema_version 1
description: The `payload` field of an `ingest.docs` stream entry whose `event_type` is `IngestionRequest`. PRD 4.1.

hash.description: Document identity: SHA-256 of the content, computed by Go.

filename.description: From the first upload. The extension selects the parser.

bucket_path.description: Ingestion bucket object key (aa/bb/<hash>), not a bucket name.

attempts.description: document_store.retries at publish. Python echoes it back unchanged.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC as emitted by Go time.Time: no fraction when zero, otherwise 1 to 9 digits with trailing zeros trimmed.
